fusions.name: Fin Through Bedrock
fusions.desc: Sends a tremor through the ground to an enemy up to 6 tiles away that erupts under it for 13 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range, knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fossil Spray
fusions.desc: Throws 3 stone teeth in a spread, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Seabed Rest
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Flint Jaws
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
